fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Railway Recruitment Cell Southern Railway (RRC-SR) has released the notification for the post of various Trade Apprentice. This recruitment has been issued for 4471 posts. Online applying process for Railway RRC SR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 has started from 28 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 27 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Railway RRC SR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 which has given below. 

 Railway Recruitment Cell Southern Railway Railway (RRC-SR)

Railway RRC SR Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 August 2026
  • Last Date : 27 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : 0/-
  • All Female Candidates : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

[adinserter block=”3″]

Railway RRC SR Apprentice Notification 2026 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 28 August 2026
  • Minimum Age : 15 Years
  • Maximum Age : 22 Years (Fresher)
  • Maximum Age : 24 Years (Ex-ITI, MLT)
  • Age Relaxation as per Railway RRC SR Apprentice Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

Railway RRC SR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 : Educational Qualification

Trade Name Eligibility 
Fresher Category
Fitter, Painter & Welder
  • Candidates must have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10, +2 System of education or its equivalent.
Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
  • Candidates must have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10, +2 system of education with Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
Ex.ITI Category
Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
  • Candidates must have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10 +2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
Electrician
  • Candidates must have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10 +2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
Electronics Mechanic
  • Candidates must have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10 +2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
  • Candidates must have passed 12th class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
  • Candidates must have passed 10th class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
COPA/PASSA
  • Candidates must have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10 +2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in “Computer Operator and Programming Assistant”
  • i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates.
  • ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.

Railway RRC SR Apprentice Online Form 2026 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://sr.indianrailways.gov.in or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the RRC SR before Last Date.
